scripts.build:bridge: dotnet publish bridge/WirelessDeviceBridge.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o bridge/dist/x64 && dotnet publish bridge/WirelessDeviceBridge.csproj -c Release -r win-arm64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o bridge/dist/arm64 && node scripts/stage-bridge.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:profiles && npm run build:assets && rollup -c && npm run build:bridge
scripts.test: npm run build:profiles && npm run build:assets && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run validate:lite && npm run validate:pro
scripts.pack: npm run pack:lite && npm run pack:pro
scripts.verify:windows: npm run build && npm test && npm run host:audit && npm run validate && npm run pack
